title: Closing the Accounts Payable Gap in Golf Operations - Ottimate
body_markdown:
# Golf is booming. Your AP process still isn’t.


Course conditions get the budget. Accounts payable gets whatever’s left. See what that costs clubs in fraud, wasted hours, and vendor friction.


## What hospitality finance teams are dealing with


Our research uncovers where hospitality AP is falling short and what high-performing teams are doing differently.


#### Invoices pile in from every direction


Pro shop, turf, F&B, and events generate invoices arriving by email, paper, and vendor portals.


#### Tee times are automated. Invoices aren't


Clubs automate tee sheets, irrigation, and turf care, yet still handle invoices and payments manually.


#### Manual reviews miss what automation catches


36% of hospitality organizations faced fraud or overpayment last year as invoice volume grew.

## About this Whitepaper


Golf is busier than ever, but most clubs still run AP the same way they did a decade ago. NGCOA and Ottimate teamed up to find out why. NGCOA brought the industry authority. Ottimate brought the AP data. Together, they built a practical framework for closing the gap.
